[[File:Green dragon icon.png|left]]
'''Green dragons''' are the weakest of the four adult [[Dragon (monster)#Chromatic Dragons|chromatic dragons]] and the weakest adult dragon that can breathe fire in ''[[RuneScape]]'', with a [[combat level]] of 63. They mainly attack with [[magic]] and long-ranged [[dragonfire]]. If the player is in [[melee]] distance, they can also use melee. As with all adult dragons, [[Dragonfire#Protection|protection against dragonfire]] is advisable; otherwise, it can deal extremely high damage (1800-3000). They can be found in various locations throughout the [[Wilderness]] as well as the [[Chaos Tunnels]]. The minimum money made upon one kill is {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Green dragonhide}}+{{GEP|Dragon bones}}|c}}.

With the exception of the [[Chaos Tunnels]], they are only found in the [[Wilderness]]. Players should ensure they have not activated [[opt-in PVP]].

Killing Green dragons for their bones and hides is an old and renowned method of money making. A combined inventory of [[dragon bones]] and [[green dragonhide]]s is worth approximately {{formatnum:{{#expr:{{GEP|Dragon bones|n}} * 14 + {{GEP|Green dragonhide|n}} * 14 round -3}}}} coins. The bones and dragonhides are commonly utilised by players training [[Prayer]] and [[Crafting]] respectively. 

If assigned as a [[Slayer task]], [[brutal green dragon]]s may take their place. This requires the completion of the [[Barbarian Firemaking]] training.

{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Ranged ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Magic ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Melee ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Wilderness Ninja Strike! - This Week In RuneScape|date=13 March 2023}}
** Green dragons removed from south-east of the [[Lava Maze]].

* {{UL|type=hotfix|update=Patch Notes (16 October 2017)|date=9 October 2017}}
** Green dragons now drop two lobsters on free worlds. Like Blue dragons, they no longer drop the bass.

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (9 October 2017)|date=9 October 2017}}
** Green dragons are now available for free players.

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (25 April 2016)|date=25 April 2016}}
** Improved respawn rates for Green Dragons.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (18 August 2014)|date=18 August 2014}}
** Tweaked Green Dragons to make sure they behave correctly in single way Wilderness.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Love Story|date=5 July 2010}}
** Graphical overhaul to chromatics, including baby variants.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 September 2009)|date=9 September 2009}}
** Improved various dragons’ fire-breath code behaviour to match the KBD's existing behaviour. The actual animation has not changed.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Demons, Dragons and Giants|date=29 August 2006}}
** Graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=update|update=RS2 Tweaks and Fixes|date=22 March 2004}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* There is a wallpaper called Return of the Wilderness that was available from 26 January 2011 that has the Green dragon featured on the right hand side of it.
* In the [[2011 Halloween event]], the player had to choose a green dragon to represent [[Death (NPC)|Death]] in statue form.
* Green dragons are the only chromatic dragons to not have an attackable baby counterpart; baby green dragons are available as a level 99 [[Baby dragon (pet)#Green|Summoning pet]] and as a [[Baby green dragon|farm animal on the player-owned farm]].
** Furthermore, none of the locations that have green dragons have any dragon eggs lying around.
* There is a rare breed of green dragons which are quite small. The only known one is [[Eski]]. 
* Prior to [[9 October]] [[2017]], the Wilderness green dragons only spawned on members worlds. 
* The green dragon in [[Wilderness]] replied to a player [[Transcript:The vampyres explain themselves#letter 5|a letter]] in [[Postbag from the Hedge|Postbag]] of the questions about dragons.
